MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. REGISTER
E. D. 7389
5 6 36

May 5 36.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your communication No. 1510 dated April 30, 1936,
and to state that the Hungarian subject Gyorgy Roman
is a bona-fide resident of the International Settlement
and nothing is known to his detriment from a criminal,
political or moral viewpoint.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为手写签名〕

Officer in Charge Special Branch.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1936年5月5日。

此致
敬礼

〔此处为手写签名〕

特别科主管警官。

J. Van den Berg 先生，
荷兰驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. **〔此处转录不清〕**
Special Branch - S2 **〔此处转录不清〕** D.
REPORT
Date. May 4, 1936.
Subject. Communication dated April 30, 1936 from Netherlands Consulate-
General re Ggorgy ROMAN, Hungarian.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by. **〔此处转录不清〕**

According to enquiries made in connection with the
attached communication dated April 30, 1936 from the Nether-
lands Consulate-General on the subject of one Ggorgy ROMAN,
Hungarian, I have to report that this person is a bona-fide
resident of the Settlement. Nothing is known that could be
construed as being detrimental to his character from either
a criminal, political or moral point of view.

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

pages.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. 85. HOLLANDIA.

No.1510.

SHANGHAI, 30 April 1936.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. C. REGISTRY / S. B. D. 7388 / 5 5 36）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the Hungarian
subject Gyorgy ROMAN intends to leave for South Africa.
He is in possession of a Hungarian passport No.
A 072413/250235, issued at Budapest on the 25th January
1931, extended two times in Budapest on the 28th January
1932 and the 13th September 1933, and the last time in
Shanghai by this Consulate on the 15th June 1935.
According to his passport he is born at Budapest
in 1904.
He is an artist (painter) by profession and arrived in
Shanghai on the 1st April 1934. From 1934 till 1935 he was
engaged by the Bakerite Co. as a chocolate maker.
Roman resides at 2a Great Western Road with Dr.D.Engel.
He states that he needs a certificate from this
Consulate that he has no criminal record, and I should be
much obliged to you if you could let me know, if possible,
whether anything is known against him from a political or
moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕

Chinese Secretary,
for Consul General for the Netherlands,
temporarily in charge of
Hungarian Interests.

〔手写批注：J.S Gitts / I.B. 1/5〕

T. Robertson, Esquire,
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

SHANGHAI.
pages.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话：85. HOLLANDIA.

第1510号。

上海，1936年4月30日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / S. C. 登记处 / S. B. D. 7388 / 5 5 36）

先生：

谨此奉告，匈牙利籍侨民 Gyorgy ROMAN 拟前往南非。其持有匈牙利护照，号码为 A 072413/250235，该护照于1931年1月25日在布达佩斯签发，并于1932年1月28日及1933年9月13日在布达佩斯延期两次，最后一次由本领事馆于1935年6月15日在上海延期。根据其护照记载，他于1904年出生于布达佩斯。

其职业为艺术家（画家），于1934年4月1日抵达上海。1934年至1935年间，受雇于 Bakerite Co. 公司担任巧克力制作师。

Roman 现与大 Engel 医生同住于大西路 2a 号。他表示需要本领事馆出具一份其无犯罪记录之证明，如蒙告知是否有任何从政治或道德角度对其不利之记录，本人将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

〔签名〕

中文秘书，
代荷兰总领事，
暂管匈牙利利益事务。

〔手写批注：J.S Gitts / I.B. 1/5〕

T. Robertson 先生，
特别科主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，

上海。
